sections.title: Text Formatting Tags
sections.content:

sections.title: Links in HTML
sections.content: A **link (hyperlink)** connects web resources — HTML documents, external webpages, or multimedia content (images, video, audio). Two things needed to create a link: 1. The file path or URL to link to. 2. The clickable text (anchor text). **The Anchor Tag ``:** Used with the **href** attribute (Hypertext Reference). Syntax: ` Clickable Text ` --- **Internal Links:** Link to a particular section of the same document. Steps: 1. Create a named anchor at the target section: ` Section Heading ` 2. Create the link pointing to it: ` Go to Section ` The `#` symbol indicates an internal target. --- **External Links:** Link to an external webpage. Syntax: ` SCERT ` When clicked, the browser opens that URL. --- **Linking Multiple Pages:** Create a master page with links to other HTML files. ` OpenOffice Writer ` On the linked page, provide a back link: ` Back to Home ` --- **HTML Link Colours (default):** - Unvisited link: underlined and blue - Visited link: underlined and purple - Active link (being clicked): underlined and red These defaults can be changed using CSS.
